answers.core: I don't know how would you do this, or if it's possible as an addon tbh...
answers.workaround: Right now I put `up_direction = get_parent().global_transform.basis.y` in the character's `_process()` function, ~but since the character (child) gets processed first and then the platform (parent) gets processed and rotates later during the same frame, the character's up_direction will always lag behind one frame with this method. To overcome this the parent platform has to be forced to process ~after~ (edit:) before it's children, which is not ideal...~

title: Add option for `CharacterBody3D.up_direction` to be local to parent (automatically follow rotating parent / platform / floor)
